title: The free energy of the system is what neurobiologists call drive

statements.text: A preferred state, such as a body temperature between 36.5 and 37.5 degrees Celsius, is a valued state the system expects to occupy. The free energy of the system is the demand for goal-directed work that resolves surprise, which is what neurobiologists call drive. Viewed from the perspective of the self-organizing system itself, this relation of selfhood to intentionality is proto-mental.
